faqs.question: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
faqs.answer: Most bathrooms take two to four weeks of work. Tile and waterproofing need curing time, which we build into the schedule.

faqs.question: Can you convert a tub to a walk-in shower?
faqs.answer: Yes. It's one of our most common jobs, and we check the plumbing and floor during the estimate.

faqs.question: Do you handle permits?
faqs.answer: Yes. We pull the permits and schedule the inspections as part of the job.
